create_VQAClassificationDataset: create a VQAClassificationDataset instance for VQA task with tokenized questions and image features
load_dataset_entries: load VQA dataset entries from JSON questions and pickle answers for train, val, or test splits
tokenize_questions: tokenize VQA questions into fixed-length token sequences with input masks and segment IDs
tensorize_dataset: convert tokenized VQA entries to PyTorch tensors for features, masks, and answer labels
getitem_VQADataset: get a VQA dataset item with padded image features, spatial boxes, and question tensors
